people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
translations.bsb: He did not refuse to confess, but openly declared, “I am not the Christ.”
translations.kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
translations.asv: And he confessed, and denied not; and he confessed, I am not the Christ.
